senses.gloss:
गोजल n. (-लं) Cow's urine.
 E. गो, and जल water. गवि जातं जलम् ।

गोजागरिक m. (-कः) A prickly nightshade.
 n. (-कं) Happy, fortunate,
auspicious.
 E. गो the earth, जागृ to wake or to be awake, affix ठक्.

गोजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A potherb growing wild. (Elephantophus scaber.)
 E. गो
a cow, and जिह्वा a tongue: the leaves being so compared; also with
कन् added गोजिह्वका.
